title: Login lockout, with one unmet criterion

pr.title: Lock an account after failed logins

task:
Lock a login after failed attempts.

Acceptance criteria:
1. After 5 failed logins within 15 minutes, the account is locked for 15 minutes.
2. A locked account gets the error "locked", also with the right password.
3. A successful login resets the count of failed logins.
4. The count and the lock are per account, not per IP address.

bugs.note: Acceptance criterion 3 is not met: a successful login does not reset the failed logins. Lockout has no reset, and login() does not clear the count, so four failures, a success, and one more failure within 15 minutes lock the account.

traps.why: Criterion 1 locks the account at the 5th failure in the window, so >= FAILS_MAX is right. > would allow a 6th try.

extras.note: login() calls failed() also for a name without an account, and Lockout never removes an entry, so _fails and _locked_until grow with each new name. A real but small issue that no criterion asks about.
